request: Fix the still-reproducing leftovers from issue #920 (release QA loose ends): (1) the site's `npm run preview` fails because astro preview is unsupported by the Vercel adapter; serve dist/client instead. (2) qa-stage.sh packaging fails in a worktree whose node_modules is a symlink (npm list reports extraneous); fail early with a clear "run npm ci in this worktree" message, and say so in the release-qa skill, which should recommend running QA from its own worktree. (3) the spec-kit extension's real-repo inventory gate fails on a stale local install; its failure message should name /install-local. (4) receipts' check snapshot copies the git index without its mtime, defeating git's racy-clean detection, so a same-size code edit within the same second is missed (test_receipts flakes 3/25); preserve the index mtime. (5) the Copilot board card shows "just now" for a spec whose record has no history, because it falls back to file mtime; only fall back to file time for specs without a record. Spec folder number must be 666.
